![Image description](https://b2b989d215c701ad63d7-288404e13f895703cf2798bf6ae95228.ssl.cf1.rackcdn.com/734655566969-350.png)

It's finally here! Sacramento's big annual winter competition is coming! Be sure to reserve your registration now!

The event will be in Bonner Gym at Del Oro High School. **This venue is different from past venues that have held SacCubing in the past.**

All competitors must be available to judge/run/scramble for the competition as per Regulation [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2). All competitors will be expected to help by judging or running for any event they are doing. Nametags will be handed out with all the information regarding what groups you will be competing in and what groups you will be helping in. If you are not competing in an event, you will not be assigned to help during that event.

items.information:
New Zealand Nationals 2018 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. In Addition New Zealand Nationals 2018 will crown the National Champions in 17 events of the World Cube Associations 18 over the course of 3 days.

items.information: Supreme South Open 2018 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

venue.address: 275 Mt Carmel Ave, Hamden, CT 06518, USA
venue.details: The competition will take place in the main gymnasium. There is a parking lot in front which has free parking.

items.information:
Quinnipiac University will host its first official WCA competition this September! We are planning a competition with a relaxed but engaging and social atmosphere, that will hopefully give the Connecticut cubing community a chance to connect.

The theme of this competition is breadth rather than depth. Our events will sample a variety of puzzle categories, from larger cubes (4x4) and different solving approaches (One-Handed, Blindfolded, Fewest Moves), to puzzles of different shapes (Pyraminx, Skewb, Square-1). All events except the traditional 3x3 speedsolve will be single rounds; Fewest Moves in particular will consist of **one** hour-long attempt.

Family, friends, and guests are welcome, but we ask competitors to let us know the number of people attending on their registration forms. The parking lot in front of the venue should be free of charge, but there are no guarantees if that particular lot reaches capacity.

We look forward to seeing you in September!

items.information: Auckland Spring 2018 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. Entry is free for spectators, no registration required. Competitors must register and pay a registration fee, see the registration page for more details. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. items.name: Swisscubing Better Be Quick 2018
items.information:

During lunch time we will do a big BBQ, so we hope that everyone will bring some salads, meat and other meals (the best option would be to bring specialities from your own region) in aim to share it with everyone.

Während der Mittagspause werden wir grillieren. Darum hoffen wir dass alle Teilnehmer etwas zu essen mitbringen (Salat, Fleisch, Spezialität von zuhause) um es mit den anderen zu Teilen. 

Mentre la pausa di mezzogiorno faremo una grigliata. Speriamo che tutti porteranno delle insalate, della carne o altre cose (il meglio sono le specialità del vostro paese) da condividere con i altri concorrenti.

The registration period is divided in two phases. The first phase starts at 20:00 on May 9th and ends at 23:59 on May 22th, while the second phase starts at 00:00 on May 23th and ends at 20:00 on May 30th. The registration fee includes basic entry fee and additional fee per event. The 2nd-phased registrant needs to pay the fee 0.5 time more than the early bird in the 1st phase of registration.

The limitation is 160 participants, based on a first-come-first-serve rule. For Chinese domestic participants, a completed registration is online registration plus prepaid registration fee via Alipay on Cubingchina. For oversea participants, if you can't pay the fee online and your registration is not accepted antomatically, pls contact the delegate via E-mail. Then we will make a reservation for you by manually accepting your registration and you can pay the fee by cash at the venue. Please check out the competition website for registration and the other information.

If you would like to cancel your registration, pls go through the registration page to do it by yourself and you will get 50% refund of the registration fee. Please keep in mind that, once you cancel the registraton, you are not able to attend the competition any more. The ending of the registration cancellation is at 00:00 on May 29th.

items.information:
Dear competitors and guests!

1. The official opening ceremony will be held on June 7, 2018 at 7 pm. According to our idea, it will be held at the main square of the city. For the ceremony we will prepare a special show with the famous speedcubers. In this regard, we recommend arriving in the city no later than 12.00 hours on June 7.

2. The base fee allows to compete in 2x2x2 Cube, 3x3x3 Cube, Skewb, Pyraminx and Clock. For any other event you will need to pay additionally 1000 KZT per event.

3. The winner of each event will receive a prize!

===========

Барлық қатысушылар мен қонақтардың назарына !!!
1. Ресми ашылу 2018 жылдың 7 маусымында сағат 19.00-де өтеді, қаланың орталық алаңында өтеді. Салтанатты ашылу рәсімі үшін атақты спидкуберлер қатысуымен шоу-бағдарлама дайындалады. Осыған байланысты біз 7-маусымда сағат 12.00-ден кешіктірмей қалаға келуді ұсынамыз.

2. Негізгі сыйақы 2x2x2 куб, 3x3x3 куб, Skewb, Pyraminx және Clock бойынша бәсекелесуге мүмкіндік береді. Кез-келген басқа іс-шараға қосымша бір оқиға үшін 1000 теңге төлеуге тура келеді.

3. Әр жарыстың жеңімпазы жүлде алады.

===========

Дополнительная информация:

Внимание всем участникам и гостям!!!

1. Официальная церемония открытия, состоится 7 июня 2018 года в 19.00 ч. По нашей задумке она будет проходить на главной площади города. Для церемонии будет подготовлена специальная шоу программа с участием именитых спидкуберов. В связи с этим рекомендуем прибыть в город не позднее 12.00 часов 7 июня.

2. Регистрационный взнос позволяет принять участие в дисциплинах: 2х2, Rubik's Cube, Skweb, Piraminx, Clock. Для участия в других дисциплинах необходимо оплатить  дополнительный взнос по 1000 тенге за каждую дисциплину.  

3. За первое место во всех дисциплинах предусмотрены призы

Any requested changes to registration before the deadline will be honored. Your registration is not complete until your name shows up on the list. If you believe you paid and your name isn't showing up, please contact us and we will work it out.
